'''Zlarbv IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Zlarbv system/Legends|Zlarbv system]] and the home to a green, tentacled [[Alien/Legends|alien]]. [[Kelko]] once encountered this alien on this planet.
